title: Sleep
learning_outcomes: Explain sleep stages in the context of sleep.
Compare and distinguish circadian rhythms in the context of sleep.
Apply sleep environment in the context of sleep.
Evaluate and justify decisions about clinical referral in the context of sleep.

lessons.title: Sleep stages
lessons.outcome: Explain sleep stages in the context of sleep.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving sleep stages; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to sleep case analysis.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain sleep stages from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of sleep stages; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Circadian rhythms
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish circadian rhythms in the context of sleep.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving circadian rhythms; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to sleep case analysis.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain circadian rhythms from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of circadian rhythms; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Sleep environment
lessons.outcome: Apply sleep environment in the context of sleep.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving sleep environment; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to sleep case analysis.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain sleep environment from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of sleep environment; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Clinical referral
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about clinical referral in the context of sleep.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving clinical referral; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to sleep case analysis.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain clinical referral from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of clinical referral; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of sleep stages; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of circadian rhythms; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of sleep environment; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of clinical referral; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
